paper.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence

evidence.section: Abstract; SIS-Bench construction and cognitive hierarchy
evidence.paraphrase: Real UAV videos support 13 tasks organized by space versus self and by perception, memory, and reasoning, directly probing retained spatial and agent-state evidence.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because it evaluates embodied spatial intelligence broadly rather than a dedicated agent-memory architecture.

2026-09-17 scope review: Real UAV video tasks explicitly include memory alongside perception and reasoning about space and self. The full benchmark is broader than its memory tasks; detailed protocol claims remain to be rechecked.
